body.summary: High risk: the security provider returned 3 scored indicator(s). Verify the recipient independently before proceeding.
recommendations: Verify the full address and network with your recipient through a trusted channel.
Do not share a seed phrase or private key. Independently inspect unexpected payment instructions.
Review coverage limits and explorer history. A small test transfer can still lose funds.

sources.name: GoPlus address security
sources.note: Available address-security fields retrieved; database coverage is not comprehensive.

limitations: This is an address-only assessment, not a transaction execution simulation.
No ownership verification, approval audit, token honeypot test or complete sanctions screening.
History and balance do not prove absence of fraud. An address can be compromised after this assessment.
